$comment: Declarative pricing for WR #18333. Amounts are USD cents. `work_requests_included` null means unlimited. Lago bills; it does NOT enforce the Free cap, so the product must enforce it using db/ plan.work_requests_included. Enterprise is priced per agent per month by contract inside contract_price_range_cents: create each contract's subscription with plan_overrides.amount_cents (one subscription per agent).

billable_metrics.name: Work requests
billable_metrics.description: One event per WR submitted. Event transaction_id is the WR id so retries deduplicate.
